reviews_5s:
5 Stars — Well-Engineered and Solid Spice Grinder

I’m not a chef, nor do I claim to be an expert in grinding spices—but I know quality when I see (and use) it. This grinder is clearly well thought out, with quality parts, solid construction, and smooth operation. It just works, and it works well.

I primarily use it to grind flax seed and chia seed, and it handles both beautifully. You can tell the designer or engineer behind this product actually cared—both about function and durability.

Hats off to whoever built this right. I’d give it 6 stars if I could.

Highly recommended.Let’s be honest—no one’s buying this thing for rosemary. This grinder is an absolute unit. Solid, heavy, and built like it could survive the apocalypse. It chews through “spices” like a champ and leaves a perfectly fluffy result every time. The lid has some serious grip, too—great if you’ve got strong hands, slightly annoying if you don’t. Just don’t let Grandma borrow it unless you want to have that conversation.I was looking at a 2'' or a 2.5'' grinder that was like, 8.00$. my better mind kicked in and told me not to go ultra cheep on this item.
Long story short I use it twice a day and its the right size. 3.5'' is the only size for your hand. Im a man with big hands.
No issues at all and can tell by its heavy construction that it will last for years. Im 1 month in.Cool As F looking no screen to rip out, smooth turning great grind! kingtop hands down makes the best grinder!! My old silver (was iridescent, at least 6yrs old) kingtop can be retired!This is a serious metal grinder… it’s capable of handling quite a bit of herbs that you’re needing to grind and with just a few turns you have perfection. It’s a large metal grinder so it’s got some weight to it and it’s not small, it fits in the palm of my hand and makes very quick work of whatever you’re grinding. Definitely worth the price too. I like the look of it as well.My favorite grinder. No kief trap, collects all ground materials in one place. Actually prefer this, no loss on ground goods!UsefulRight out of the box you get an incredible smooth product. No hitching between grinding plates and a strong magnetic connection on the top plate to keep the contents of the grinder sealed while grinding. The capture chamber on the bottom holds quite a bit before needing to be emptied which allows you to grind in bulk and then move to a permanent container for your ground contents. Highly recommend, would buy again!I just bought my third KingTop grinder, so I guess you can say I’m a fan! They’re super nice, high quality and very easy to use. Honestly, you can’t beat the price too. These grinders are pretty durable, a decent size, and the chambers hold a significant amount of “herb”. I believe I purchased my first one in 2016. After a few years I like to refresh but always prefer this brand. This time around I went with a fun iridescent color as opposed to my usual gold. The only difference with this one is there’s no keef catcher BUT I honestly don’t mind if it’s mixed in with the ground herb for a better affect.Great for herbs or whatever
